suite: DOI mail links: GET read-only page + POST click (security review 2026-11-09, finding 1: link prefetch)
description: Every case runs for each flow in 'flows' (newsletter /api/confirm, lead /api/lead/confirm, selfcheck /api/selfcheck/confirm). Setup: one submission in locale 'lang' (default de) -> one DOI mail -> its token. Steps run in order. Step fields: method GET|HEAD|POST; token valid (default) | tampered; repeat (default 1); POST only: body form (default, field token) | json | empty | dup (token twice) | oversized (> 2048 bytes) | query (token only in the URL, empty form); origin mauxy (default, https://mauxy.test) | foreign | null | absent; referer absent (default) | mauxy | foreign. expect: page (200 + confirmation form) | neutral (200 uniform neutral page) | neutral403 | ok (303 to the website's confirmed page of the flow) | any (only side effects are checked). After the steps: expect_writes none = no Odoo write, no mail beyond the DOI mail, DB unchanged when db_unchanged is true; once = side effects present. then_click_works: a normal human click afterwards still confirms (token not burnt).

cases.name: GET renders the confirmation page and changes nothing
scanner: repeated GET + HEAD never write, token stays usable
human click: GET page, POST form -> 303 confirmed, side effects once
replay: second POST and later GET -> neutral, nothing twice
CSRF: POST from a foreign Origin -> 403, token untouched
CSRF: Origin null (sandboxed frame / data URL) -> 403
no Origin, Referer = mauxy page -> confirmed
neither Origin nor Referer (privacy tools) -> token is the capability
POST with a JSON body (not our form) -> neutral, nothing written
POST with an empty form -> neutral
POST with the token field twice -> neutral
POST body larger than 2048 bytes -> neutral
POST with the token only in the query string -> neutral
tampered token: GET and POST -> neutral
English submission: English page, English confirmed page
